name: The Witness
fieldReading: What you carry home is the only copy.
bio: The one who remembers everything. Holds the whole night while the rest of you disappear into it, and hands it back the next day.
sceneStory: At the rim of a canyon overlooking a valley flooded with glowing light, a figure raises both hands and draws them slowly upward. The whole scene below lifts and spools into a long ribbon of light that winds up and coils around them.
assignments: Hang back and take it in
